idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: Silent Toilet Leaks: The Simple Dye Test Every Homeowner Should Know
description: A leaking toilet can waste hundreds of gallons of water a month, often without making a single sound. To test for a silent leak, remove the toilet tank lid and add a few drops of dark food coloring into the tank water. Wait about 15 to 20 minutes without flushing. If colored water appears in the toilet bowl, your flapper or flush valve seal is leaking and letting water seep through continuously. Replacing a worn flapper is a common fix, but if the water continues to run or you notice leaks around the base, it is best to have a professional plumber inspect the internal components.
